responsibility: Defines the DFA scheduling model for the SiFive P600 microarchitecture. It models the quad-issue out-of-order pipeline structure, execution resources, instruction latencies, reservations, and bypass behavior for integer, branch, memory, atomic, multiply/divide, and floating-point classes under `-mtune=sifive_p600`, providing a processor-specific scheduler description separate from the P400, SiFive 7-series, and generic models.
